final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.district_id AS did, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.region, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total) AS avg_ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.region
